name: cut green oak limb
description: a large, cut, green limb with light gray bark
details: A large limb, cut cleanly from the trunk at its base.  Its bark is light gray and scaly, its twigs are reddish-brown and hairless, and small, blunt, reddish-brown buds cluster at the twig tips.  The wood is still green and heavy with sap, and wilting leaves, bright green above and paler beneath, cling to the twigs.
keywords: cut green oak limb cut limb green limb large limb light gray scaly bark reddish-brown hairless twigs blunt reddish-brown buds green wood
